erd: After a shared early positive transient, mu power falls below baseline more strongly for fists at C3 (0–4 s mean -9.8%) and C4 (-4.7%) than for feet (+1.3% and -1.2%). At Cz, feet show only slightly more mean desynchronization (-2.2%) than fists (-0.6%), with substantial fluctuations. The stronger lateral fist response and weak medial foot contrast are broadly compatible with hand/foot somatotopy but do not provide a clean spatial dissociation. Weak Cz could reflect source mixing, reference choice, intersubject variation, noise or cue-related activity; this plot alone cannot identify the cause.
